subject: Large intestine
hook: LARGE INTESTINE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The large intestine is not called 'large' because of its length, but rather because of its diameter.
angle_support: Although it is shorter than the small intestine, it is called the large intestine because it is wider in diameter.
title: Why is the Large Intestine called Large?
description: Many people assume the large intestine is named for its length, but it is actually much shorter than the small intestine. Its name comes from the fact that it is significantly wider in diameter.
narration: LARGE INTESTINE IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture an organ that is longer than the small intestine. It was never about length. The name actually refers to its much wider diameter compared to others. Despite being significantly shorter than the small intestine, this section of the digestive tract possesses a much broader lumen. Its cecum alone measures roughly nine centimeters across, making it the widest part of the entire human bowel system. It is called large simply because of its impressive internal width.
